DE:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} steht endlich
an! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Das große Turnier für alle
Insektensammler!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Mich juckt's schon in den Fingern{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
und auch sonst überall! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Verflixte
Insekten!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Sonunda {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} geldi! Böcek
yakalama turnuvası! Başlamak
için yerimde duramıyorum!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}} Bir yandan da
kaşınıyorum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}

EN:
I've been waiting for this day!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} I'm
gonna show the world my pro bug-
catching moves!
ES:
¡Estaba deseando que llegase
este día!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡Voy a enseñarle al mundo
mis llaves para inmovilizar bichos!
FR:
Ça fait longtemps que j'attends ce
jour !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Je vais enfin pouvoir dévoiler
ma nouvelle technique secrète !
IT:
Mi sono allenato tanto per questo
momento!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Il mondo intero vedrà le
mie mosse speciali cattura insetti!
DE:
Endlich ist es so weit!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Endlich kann
ich der ganzen Welt zeigen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}was für
ein toller Insektensammler ich bin!
TRANSLATION:
Bu günü bekliyordum!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Profesyonel böcek
yakalama hareketlerimi
dünyaya göstereceğim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aha! The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} hasn't started
yet!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}} But I already finished my
warm-up!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡La Caza de Bichos todavía no ha
empezado!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}} ¡Pero ya he terminado
con mi calentamiento! ¿Qué hago?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ah! L'Insettomania non è ancora
iniziata!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}} Ma io mi sono già
riscaldato!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aha! {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} daha başlamadı!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}
Ama ben ısınmamı çoktan bitirdim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}It's good to be all enthusiastic
about today's {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, but you also
need to make sure you warm up!
There. I warned you. I can't be held
responsible{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0013:}} for what will happen if
you don't warm up, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Sí, sí, mucha risita con la Caza de
Bichos y todo eso, ¡pero hay que
acordarse de hacer calentamientos!
Luego no digas que no te lo advertí.
¡No me hago responsable{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0013:}} de lo que
te pase si me ignoras, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
L'entusiasmo va bene, {{TAG:0003:0006:}}ma non
basta. Bisogna riscaldarsi per bene
prima dell'Insettomania!
Mi hai sentito? Io ti ho avvertit{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}:
{{TAG:0003:0013:}}potresti avere dei guai se non
lo fai, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Vorfreude hin oder her{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wer sich
auch NACH dem {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
freuen will, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}muss sich aufwärmen!
Ich will dich später nicht jammern
hören, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0013:}}dass du dich nicht
aufgewärmt fühlst, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bugünkü {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} için coşkulu
olmak güzel, ama ısınmayı da ihmal etme!
İşte, uyardım. Isınmazsan başına
geleceklerden{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0013:}} ben sorumlu
değilim, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN: {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yes! The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} begins! I'm ready!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Sí! ¡Comienza la Caza de Bichos!
¡Estoy listo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ouais !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est parti pour
l'insectosafari !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Planquez-vous les
insectes,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0001:}} arrive !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Evviva! Inizia l'Insettomania!
Sono prontissimo!
TRANSLATION: {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Evet! {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} başlıyor! Hazırım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is a long battle.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Just
like with a marathon, you've gotta
keep pushing, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}La Caza de Bichos es una carrera
muy larga.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Hay que aguantar como
en una maratón, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}L'insectosafari, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}c'est une épreuve
d'endurance.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est comme un marathon,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sauf
qu'on court avec un filet dans la
main, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}L'Insettomania è come
una maratona.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} L'importante
è non arrendersi, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Who do you think will win the big
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} this time?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! It's gonna be me, of course!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Quién crees que ganará
esta Caza de Bichos?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Ja, ja, ja! ¡Pues yo, por supuesto!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Have you caught any bugs,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? Catch as many as you
can! Give me a real challenge!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Has atrapado ya algún bicho,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? ¡Caza todos los que
puedas! ¡Pónmelo un poco difícil!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hai catturato molti insetti,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? Dai, fammi vedere
cosa sai fare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Konntest du schon irgendwelche
Insekten einfangen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Fang so viele du kannst!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ohne
echte Konkurrenz kann ich auch
keinen Weltrekord aufstellen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hiç böcek yakaladın mı, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
Yakalayabildiğin kadar yakala! Bana
gerçek bir meydan okuma çıkar!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}¡Bichejos escurridizos!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} De pronto
pegan un bote o se van volando y
te dejan con un palmo de narices{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Quiero entrenarme para ser
tan ágil como ellos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Les insectes sont de sacrés filous !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
On sait jamais s'ils vont se mettre
à voler,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sauter{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ou courir{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}J'aimerais bien devenir aussi agile
et imprévisible qu'eux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Gli insetti sono sfuggenti, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Volano, saltano e schizzano
via all'improvviso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Devo allenarmi di più e diventare
inafferrabile come loro!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Insekten sind fiese kleine Feiglinge,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Kaum sehen sie dich, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}schon
machen sie sich aus dem Staub{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Nur echte Champs wie ich können
sie dann noch schnappen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Böcekler ne kadar sinsi, değil mi?
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Uçuyorlar, zıplıyorlar, hop diye
kaçıyorlar{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ben de onlar gibi olmak
için antrenman yapmak istiyorum!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Lui là-bas ! Et puis lui aussi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}} Je te
jure que je vais les attraper{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}, à
mains nues s'il le faut !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Şuradaki böcek delisi, buradaki
diğeri{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}} Yine de kimse beni geçemez,
garanti veriyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Aiieee! Giant bug!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Oh! It's you, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}} Sheesh!
For a second there, I thought I was
gonna need a bigger net!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Aaaaah! ¡Un bicho gigante!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Huy! ¡Si eres tú, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}} Qué
susto me has dado. Ya pensaba que
iba a necesitar una red más grande.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Aaaargh ! L'abominable
mille-pattes-garou
{{TAG:0005:001F:00CD}}-ivore !
Ah !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} C'est toi {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}} Pfiouuu !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
J'ai cru que c'était à mon tour de
finir dans le filet d'un autre !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Aiuto! Un insetto enorme!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Oh! Sei tu, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}} Pensavo
mi servisse un retino più grande!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Aaaah! Dev böcek!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Aa! Senmişsin,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}} Of be! Bir an daha büyük
bir ağa ihtiyacım olacak sandım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Is this really the best time for a
chat? The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is almost over,
you know.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}As a true sportsman, I want to hunt
bugs until the bitter end!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Tú crees que es buen momento
para charlar? ¡La Caza de Bichos
está a punto de terminar!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Yo al competir lo doy todo al
límite hasta el último minuto,
¡vaya como vaya la competición!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tu crois vraiment que c'est le
moment de discuter ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} On entre
dans la dernière ligne droite,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} là.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}En tant que sportif accompli,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je ne
relâcherai pas mes efforts avant le
coup de sifflet final !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Vuoi veramente metterti a parlare?
L'Insettomania sta per finire...
Non c'è tempo da perdere.
Io sono uno sportivo. {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Gareggio
fino alla fine!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ich hab jetzt echt keine Zeit zum
Schnattern!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
ist fast rum.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Und ein Sportass wie ich kämpft
bis zum bitteren Ende!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Şimdi sohbet etmenin sırası
mı gerçekten? {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} bitmek
üzere, biliyorsun.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Gerçek bir sporcu olarak son saniyeye
kadar böcek avlamak istiyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I'm determined to make it to the
winner's podium!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Time for one last push! Here I go!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Estoy decidido a hacerme
con el podio!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}¡Tengo que esforzarme en el sprint
final! ¡Allá voy, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Je suis bien déterminé à finir sur le
podium des vainqueurs !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}C'est le moment d'activer ma
botte secrète, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Devo impegnarmi al massimo
per salire sul podio!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Un ultimo sforzo! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich werd alles geben, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}um am Ende
aufs Siegertreppchen zu kommen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Und deshalb wird's Zeit für den
berühmten {{TAG:0005:0001:}}-Endspurt!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Los geht's, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Kazananlar kürsüsüne çıkmaya
kararlıyım!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Son bir yüklenme zamanı!
Hadi gidiyorum!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Don't give up! Even if there's only
one second left! Keep at it! That's
true sportsmanship!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡No te rindas! ¡Aunque solo queden
tres segundos! ¡Hay que demostrar
que te lo tomas en serio!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}N'abandonne jamais !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Même s'il ne
reste plus qu'une seconde,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ne lâche
rien !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est ça l'esprit sportif !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mai arrendersi! Anche se manca
un solo secondo alla fine.
Gli sportivi come me non mollano!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Niemals aufgeben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Auch wenn alles
gegen dich läuft! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Das Ergebnis,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} die
Uhr, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}das Glück!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Das macht ein echtes Sportass aus!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Vazgeçme! Bir saniye bile kalmış olsa
devam et! Gerçek sportmenlik budur!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is over, but I just can't
relax!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Se acabó la Caza de Bichos,
¡pero todavía hay que esperar!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}L'insectosafari est terminé,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} mais il
est encore trop tôt pour que je
me détende !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}L'Insettomania è finita, ma
proprio non riesco a rilassarmi!
TRANSLATION: {{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} bitti ama hâlâ gevşeyemiyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I'm looking forward to the awards
ceremony! All I have to do is believe
in myself and wait, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Qué ganas tengo de que den los
premios! ¡Sé que se reconocerá
mi superioridad, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}J'ai hâte que la remise des prix
commence !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mais tout ce qu'il y a à
faire,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'est attendre, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Non vedo l'ora che cominci la
premiazione! Sono convinto del
mio ottimo risultato, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich freu mich schon tierisch auf die
Siegerehrung! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Aber jetzt heißt's
erst mal abwarten, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ödül törenini dört gözle bekliyorum! Tek
yapmam gereken kendime inanıp
beklemek, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du warst echt nicht übel unterwegs
beim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ich muss sogar zugeben{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} dass du
besser warst als ich!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du bist ein
echter Siegertyp!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Beim nächsten Mal hab ich aber
wieder die Nase vorn, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Aw, barbells! I can't believe you
beat me in the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I'm gonna start training right now
in preparation for the next event,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Pero bueno! ¡No puedo creer
que me hayas superado en la
Caza de Bichos!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Voy a tener que entrenarme desde
ya para que esto no vuelva a ocurrir
en la próxima, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Argh !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Nom d'une mouche qui pète !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
J'arrive pas à croire que tu m'aies
battu !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Il va falloir que je m'entraîne dur
pour te battre lors du prochain
concours, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}No! Non riesco a credere che
tu mi abbia battuto!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Devo andare subito ad allenarmi
per essere pronto alla prossima
sfida, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}So ein Pfostenschuss! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Wie konntest
du mich nur beim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
schlagen?!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich fang gleich mit dem Training für
das nächste Turnier an!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Noch so 'ne Niederlage würde mein
Sportass-Herz nicht verkraften,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ah, dambıllar aşkına! {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nda
beni yendiğine inanamıyorum! {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bir sonraki
etkinlik için hazırlığa hemen şimdi
başlıyorum, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}You totally beat me in the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}You really looked like an athlete up
there on the winner's podium!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000E:}}I got
a little bit teary eyed!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}¡Me has dado una buena paliza en
la Caza de Bichos, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡En el podio parecías u{{TAG:000E:0006:02006E0004006E006100}} atleta
de alta competición!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000E:}}¡No veas
qué emoción llegué a sentir!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Tu m'as flanqué une sacrée
raclée, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}T'avais l'air {{TAG:000E:0006:08006400270075006E000A006400270075006E006500}} véritable athlète
sur le podium !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000E:}}Qu'est-ce que
j'aurais voulu être à ta place !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Mi hai stracciato all'Insettomania,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Sembravi proprio {{TAG:000E:0006:0E0075006E0020007600650072006F00100075006E00610020007600650072006100}} atleta
su quel podio!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000E:}}Mi sono quasi
commosso!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Dein Triumph über mich beim
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} war wirklich
verdient, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Und auf dem Siegertreppchen hast
du ausgesehen wie ein Champ!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}
